mainEntity.name: Why flat rate for long distance?

acceptedAnswer.text: Because distance, traffic, and weather stretch an hourly bill in ways nobody can predict. A flat rate moves that risk to us: the number in writing is the number you pay.

mainEntity.name: Can you move my safe or piano long-distance?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes — 1,500 to 3,500 lb assets move under SIR and KIM-GS, with route survey and L/360 floor check at either end.

mainEntity.name: How much does a long distance move cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: One flat rate per job, agreed in writing before move day. The rate is set from the survey — what is moving, the distance, the access at both ends and any heavy pieces — and it does not change because the road runs long: Guaranteed Flat Rate or Your Move is Free! No price is quoted before the survey, because the flat rate is set from your actual move. Hourly pricing is available when a client asks for it.

mainEntity.name: How far in advance should I book a long distance move?

acceptedAnswer.text: As early as you can — the survey comes first, and the flat rate is set from it. Booking ahead gives the widest choice of move days and time to plan any heavy-asset work at both ends; call +1-540-422-2153 and the move is surveyed, then priced once, in writing.
